sources.name: Andorran Financial Authority feeds
sources.summary: Main and category RSS or Atom feeds for alerts, press releases, new regulation and financial education.
sources.coverage: AFA alerts, press releases, new regulation and financial-education feed items.
sources.license: Feed redistribution terms were not checked; use for live retrieval and link to the original item.

endpoints.desc: Retrieve the AFA main RSS feed.
endpoints.returns: RSS or Atom XML feed with financial regulator item metadata.

endpoints.desc: Retrieve a category feed for alerts, press releases, new regulation or financial education.
endpoints.returns: RSS or Atom XML containing items for the selected AFA category.

gotchas: AFA Plone REST API search requires a permission that anonymous users do not have; use public XML feeds instead.
The /ca/categories-home/educacio-financiera/RSS request timed out at 30 seconds on 2026-10-02; one unavailable category can make aggregation partial.

sources.name: Butlletí Oficial del Principat d'Andorra
sources.summary: Full-text search over official bulletins and live HTML or PDF access to published documents from 1989 onward.
alerts: GetDocumentsByBOPA for bulletin 100 in 2026 reported 194 records but returned 184; continue paging and deduplicate instead of trusting totalCount.
sources.license: Reuse including copying, adaptation, extraction, redistribution and public communication is allowed subject to preserving metadata and update dates, not distorting meaning, and not implying BOPA endorsement.

endpoints.desc: Search indexed bulletin documents with optional text, date, organization, topic, and paging filters.
endpoints.example: curl -sS -X POST "https://bopaazurefunctions.azurewebsites.net/api/GetPaginatedDocuments2Indexes?code=$BOPA_FUNCTION_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"textSearch":"habitatge","temaFilter":[],"dateFilter":[],"organismeFilter":[],"butlletiFilter":"","anyFilter":[],"size":25,"skip":0,"orderBy":"AnyButlleti desc, NumButlleti desc, DataArticle desc,OrganismeOrder,OrganismeChildOrder","searchMode":1}'
endpoints.returns: JSON object with matching document metadata, score and highlights; results are paged by size and skip.

endpoints.desc: Retrieve documents belonging to one bulletin number and publication year.
endpoints.returns: JSON object with totalCount and document records; observed count can exceed returned records.

endpoints.desc: Fetch a document blob using its publication-year folder and file name.
endpoints.returns: HTML document text or a PDF byte stream; folder is publication year minus 1988 followed by bulletin number.

gotchas: Function keys are scraped from the public frontend JavaScript and can rotate after a deployment; never hard-code one.
Search strips the specified Catalan accents and replaces percent signs with the word percentage before sending text.
The document blob folder uses publication year rather than any year embedded in the document name.
GetDocumentsByBOPA requires year; omitting it returned HTTP 500 in the inventory.
tips: Keep the publication date and BOPA terms metadata when redistributing documents.
Older scanned PDF text may need OCR; OCR behavior has not been checked.

sources.name: e-tramits procedures
sources.summary: Searchable HTML catalog of 645 administrative procedures in Catalan, Spanish and French.
alerts: GET /search/?text=vehicle&q=%3Arelevance ignores text, returns 645 procedures and has unstable relevance ordering; GET /search/?text=vehicle returns 45.
sources.coverage: Current procedure catalog, with language variants in Catalan, Spanish and French.
sources.license: All rights reserved under Govern d'Andorra terms; this project fetches pages live and cites them, and does not redistribute their content.

endpoints.desc: Search the procedure catalog in pages of 20; omit q when searching by text.
endpoints.returns: HTML result cards with procedure code, title and canonical detail URL; empty query reports 645 results.

endpoints.desc: Retrieve one procedure detail page; select Spanish or French with the lang query parameter.
endpoints.returns: HTML and JSON-LD containing procedure sections, forms, price, maximum resolution time, online availability and appointment requirements.

endpoints.desc: Enumerate the complete procedure catalog in stable alphabetical order.
endpoints.returns: Twenty HTML procedure cards per page and a total-result count; inventory contains 645 procedures.

gotchas: The text parameter is ignored whenever q is set; relevance-sorted paging changes order between requests. Search with text and no q, and enumerate with q=:name-asc until the reported total is reached.
Sitemap /tramits/sitemap.xml is an empty sitemap index; enumerate by paging search until no new procedure codes appear.
Spanish and French variants use lang=es or lang=fr; GV000484 redirects to a code-only localized path such as /tramits//p/GV000484?lang=es.
The Govern's rights notice prohibits republication without prior written consent, so only fetch live and cite links.
tips: Preserve the exact procedure code, language and official URL when presenting information.

sources.name: Andorra Department of Statistics API
sources.summary: Public API for 2,709 statistical tables with search, topic groups, JSON-stat data, CSV, XLSX and SDMX exports.
sources.coverage: Varies by table; table 1070 returned 134 rows through 2026-06 in the checked quarterly series.
sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International for statistics owned by the Department; third-party data may have other terms.

endpoints.desc: Search divisions and statistical tables by non-empty text.
endpoints.returns: JSON array of table divisions with IdDivision, Division and Description.

endpoints.desc: Retrieve a table as JSON-stat 2.0 with explicit period bounds.
endpoints.returns: JSON-stat 2.0 dataset with ordered id and size arrays, dimension labels, values and update metadata.

endpoints.desc: Retrieve the topic hierarchy for levels one through three.
endpoints.returns: JSON tree of 3 top-level, 18 second-level and 69 third-level topic groups.

gotchas: searchDivision requires text and returns HTTP 400 when the text parameter is omitted.
/data returned HTTP 400 invalid or missing parameters when startDate and endDate were omitted from table 1070.
CSV is UTF-8 with BOM, semicolon-separated, and uses a decimal comma.
Period codes vary with table periodicity, for example 2010/03 quarterly and 2010 annual.
tips: Request startDate=1900 and endDate=2100 to ask for the full available table range.
Search on common vowels and deduplicate IdDivision values when assembling a broad table index.

sources.name: Govern d'Andorra information pages
sources.summary: Liferay information pages from Govern d'Andorra, indexed by section headings and fetched live for cited content.
sources.coverage: Public information pages in the Catalan sitemap, including thematic and ministry pages.
sources.license: All rights reserved under Govern d'Andorra terms; this project fetches pages live and cites them, and does not redistribute page content. Its local index stores titles, URLs and section headings only.

endpoints.desc: List Catalan thematic and ministry pages with sitemap last-modified dates.
endpoints.returns: Sitemap XML with page URLs and lastmod values; news URLs under /ca/w/ can be excluded.

endpoints.desc: Retrieve a live Govern information page and parse its Liferay content sections.
endpoints.returns: Page title, description, language, final URL and titled article-section text.

gotchas: The root sitemap.xml is an index of per-layout sitemaps that are empty; use /ca/sitemap.xml and index only Catalan pages.
The Catalan sitemap is stale; in a 30-URL sample, 18 returned 200, 10 redirected and 2 returned 404, so keep final URLs and drop errors.
Spanish, French and English sitemaps contain only 70–103 URLs each and are not a complete catalog.
robots.txt disallows /cerca?q=; do not use Govern's site search.
Liferay content lives in journal-content-article blocks; omit Prefooter, Redes sociales, -Tabs and empty sections.
Page titles use the - Govern d’Andorra suffix; local index entries may contain only titles, URLs and section headings.
tips: Fetch page bodies live, cite their final official URLs and do not redistribute their content.
Use content sections such as Import as evidence rather than page-navigation text.

sources.name: Govern d'Andorra ArcGIS Enterprise

sources.coverage: Andorra; layer-specific time coverage and update dates.
sources.license: All rights reserved under Govern d'Andorra terms; layer licenses were not stated, so this project fetches live and cites links without redistributing layer content.

endpoints.desc: Query an ArcGIS feature layer; see the curated layer whitelist in the client.
endpoints.returns: Checked 2026-10-02: carburants_stations 75; carburants_prices 275; aadt 13,218; weather_stations 33; streets 1,392; population 44; tourism_pois 395; bus_lines 12; parishes 9.

endpoints.desc: List layer ids and names for a service before querying.
endpoints.returns: ArcGIS service JSON with layers containing numeric ids and names.

gotchas: A layer id is not necessarily zero; inspect the service layer list before querying.
ArcGIS errors such as 499 Token Required may be returned inside an HTTP 200 JSON object.
Non-ASCII service names such as Diària and Població must be URL-encoded.
Some feature services have not been updated since 2020 and layer licensing metadata is empty.
tips: Use the curated whitelist in fonts_andorra.clients.arcgis rather than searching the full portal.
